title: Progress update on my god game!
author: Sarcospam
selftext: been working on my god game for a little over a month now using claude opus 5.5 to assist, im so keen to release it to playtesters soon! let me know what you think!

comments.author: unfamily_friendly
comments.body: Finally, someone remaking black and white

replies.author: UndeniablyIffy
replies.body: there's like 5 people doing this and posting about it on reddit, who knows how many are doing this behind the scenes

replies.author: unfamily_friendly
replies.body: I didn't notice the others, but i do believe you. The game is so old, all the people who liked it probably has partial balding and hemorrhoids

replies.author: Sarcospam
replies.body: i like it and sadly i do have those issues XD i am old

comments.author: DragonWolf888
comments.body: How is this better than Black & White? What is your unique take?

replies.author: Sarcospam
replies.body:
better? im not sure if i could live up to that gem of a game, but my unique take is this is the version of a god game that i want to play, where your choices matter, gods and villagers respond to your changes in real time, and having actual prayers to answer that are open ended which control alignment based on the players choices.

also you can run my god game on a modern PC.
